inputs.text: This Jaipur graduation thing is no random student outburst at all. A kid calls out administrative problems right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister and it suddenly explodes online with the usual divide-and-conquer reactions? The university's complete silence is the dead giveaway that they're all coordinated behind the scenes. The elites and institutions are clearly using this to manufacture public distraction, test how far they can push narrative control over education, and keep real problems buried while pretending it's just about some debate on student rights. Don't fall for the surface story; it's classic hidden manipulation at work.
